clue.text: Hunt runs in frantic chase

indicators.note: something frantic is wild and disordered, so the word beside it gets jumbled
one item is placed inside another, so the single letter goes into the jumble

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged
R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A posse dashes about in a frantic chase after a fugitive.
explanation.definitionFit: To search is to look hard for something, the same as a hunt for it.

clue.text: Kind of course that provides something to eat between rounds

blocks.note: first meaning: a degree course with a work placement in the middle
second meaning: a filling eaten between two rounds of bread

explanation.walkthrough: 'Rounds' hints at golf or boxing, but a round is a slice of bread. A sandwich course is a British degree with a year in industry sandwiched between years of study.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a study course split by work experience and a filled bread snack.

clue.text: Dealing with an attack of disease?

blocks.note: first meaning: concerning, on the subject of
second meaning, split in two: a single spell of illness

explanation.walkthrough: The second sense splits the answer into two words, an article plus a spell of illness, which the question mark flags.
explanation.definitionFit: A book about a topic is dealing with it, and a bout of flu is an attack of it.

clue.text: Restrict murderer oddly not put inside

indicators.note: oddly means in a strange way, so the word's letters are scrambled
put inside tells us to place the jumbled letters within the other word

blocks.note: Cain killed his brother Abel in Genesis
taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: Restrain a killer who, strangely, has not been jailed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Oddly' tempts one to take odd letters; here it signals a jumble.
explanation.definitionFit: To contain something is to hold it back or keep it within limits, to restrict it.

clue.text: Conservative legislation covering leader of union in plant

indicators.note: to cover something is to wrap around it, so the legislation goes round the letter
a leader comes at the front, so only the opening letter is kept

blocks.note: C is the standard abbreviation for Conservative
Acts of Parliament are legislation
the first letter of union

explanation.surface: A Tory law hems in a trade union boss within some industrial plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' looks like a factory in this political scene, but it is the botanical sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A cactus is a spiny succulent, one example of a plant.

clue.text: Install as a head, holding power

indicators.note: holding means gripping within, so the headland phrase surrounds the letter

blocks.note: a point is a head of land jutting into the sea
P is the abbreviation for power

explanation.surface: Someone is installed as headteacher, keeping hold of power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Head' suggests a boss; here it is a headland, also called a point.
explanation.definitionFit: To appoint someone is to put them into a post, to install them.

clue.text: Street cop given new order that's hush-hush

indicators.note: a new order means a different sequence, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A beat officer receives a confidential instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: Hush-hush is informal for highly confidential, which is what top secret means.

clue.text: Start work on canvas in small sailing boat

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for small
a ketch is a two-masted sailing vessel

explanation.surface: Someone begins a painting on a little boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Canvas' suggests sails, fitting the boat; it is a painter's canvas.
explanation.definitionFit: Drawing a rough outline is how a painter begins a picture on canvas.

clue.text: No problem for top minion, as arranged

indicators.note: things arranged are put into a fresh order, so the preceding letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: A top boss's underling fixes things so they are no bother for the boss.
explanation.walkthrough: A spinning top that turns so smoothly it looks still is said to 'sleep', so a top never has trouble sleeping.
explanation.definitionFit: Insomnia is inability to sleep, and a top is proverbially good at sleeping, so it is no problem for one.

clue.text: Removing disorderly brats before court case

definitions.note: a gerund used as a noun, matching the noun answer

indicators.note: disorderly means out of order, so these letters are jumbled

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged
a legal action is a court case

explanation.surface: Unruly kids are taken out of the room before a trial begins.
explanation.definitionFit: Abstraction can mean the act of taking something away, the same as removing it.

clue.text: Person easily manipulated, that might be on hand

blocks.note: first meaning: someone controlled by another
second meaning: a glove figure worn over the hand

explanation.walkthrough: 'On hand' looks like 'available', but it is literal: a glove version is worn on the hand.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a person controlled by others and a figure worked by strings or fitted over a performer's hand.

clue.text: Fool that was improperly taught, initially

indicators.note: initially points to the beginning of each word, so the opening letters are kept

blocks.note: the first letters of these four words

explanation.surface: Someone sounds silly because their teaching was poor.
explanation.definitionFit: Twit is a mild British insult for a silly or foolish person.

clue.text: Not having any money — what's heart-warming about that?

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the heart-warming thing wraps round the money

blocks.note: from the saying that absence makes the heart grow fonder
tin is old slang for money

explanation.surface: Being broke: what could be heart-warming about that?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not having any money' reads as one phrase, but the definition stops at 'any'.
explanation.definitionFit: Abstinence is refraining from something, choosing not to have any of it.

clue.text: Script producer and entire crew's revised, finally right

indicators.note: text that is revised gets reworked, so these letters are put in a new order
finally means at the end, so this letter is added last

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: A film script gets revised by the whole crew until it is finally right.
explanation.definitionFit: A screenwriter is the person who produces the script for a film.

clue.text: Basis of health, wealth and wisdom one's seen in noble head

definitions.text: Basis of health, wealth and wisdom

indicators.note: something seen in a thing sits inside it, so one letter goes in the middle

blocks.note: an earl is a nobleman
a ness is a headland
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A lord's mind holds the secret to health, wealth and wisdom.
explanation.walkthrough: The saying is 'early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise'. 'One's' is read as 'one is'.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb credits rising early with making one healthy, wealthy and wise, so being early is its basis.

clue.text: Altered on the sly, believe me!

indicators.note: something altered is changed, so the following letters take a new order

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone protests that a document was not secretly doctored.
explanation.walkthrough: Ironic, since the surface protests sincerity about something done deceitfully.
explanation.definitionFit: Both exclamations are used to insist that one is telling the truth.

clue.text: Improvement to house — addition of bar?

blocks.note: first meaning: repainting and refurbishing a home
second meaning: a bar added to a military medal is a further decoration

explanation.walkthrough: 'Bar' suggests a drinks bar fitted in a house; it is the clasp added to a medal when it is awarded again, a 'decoration' given a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers doing up a home afresh and, read as re-decoration, a medal being awarded once more.

clue.text: Medic acts badly about onset of illness that's severe

indicators.note: acting badly means doing it wrongly, so the word is scrambled
about means surrounding, so the jumble goes round a letter
an onset is a beginning, so only the first letter is used

blocks.note: Dr is short for doctor
taken as written, then rearranged
the first letter of illness

explanation.surface: A doctor behaves terribly in response to a serious illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Drastic means extreme or harsh in effect, close in sense to severe.

clue.text: A doctor, in row, went berserk

indicators.note: in places the first pair of words inside the row

blocks.note: a rank is a row, as of soldiers
A plus MO, a medical officer

explanation.surface: A doctor caught up in an argument lost control.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' suggests a quarrel; it is a line.
explanation.definitionFit: To run amok is to behave in a wild, uncontrolled way, going berserk.

clue.text: Have discussion about working capital

blocks.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about
a machine that is working is on
capital and fab are both slang for excellent

explanation.surface: Talk about running money for a business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' looks financial, beside 'working capital'; it is the old exclamation meaning splendid.
explanation.definitionFit: To confab is to chat or confer, an informal shortening of confabulate.

clue.text: Gift divided by male, one in total control

indicators.note: something divided is split apart, letting other letters sit in the gap

blocks.note: a donation is a gift
M is the abbreviation for male
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A present gets shared out by a man who holds all the power.
explanation.definitionFit: Domination is mastery over others, holding complete control.

clue.text: Signals left out of things like this

indicators.note: something left out of a group is taken away, so a letter is dropped

blocks.note: L is the abbreviation for left
this line is itself a crossword clue

explanation.surface: Signals are being omitted from clues like this one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left' looks like a verb meaning omitted, but it is the abbreviation removed from CLUES.
explanation.definitionFit: Cues are signals, such as a prompt telling an actor when to speak.

clue.text: Sound made by large gun, as a rule

indicators.note: sound made by tells us we want something that is spoken the same as the gun

blocks.note: a cannon is a large gun

explanation.surface: As a rule, a big gun makes a loud bang.
explanation.definitionFit: A canon is a general principle or law, a rule.

clue.text: Impact fellow with iron, in turn

indicators.note: in places the preceding pair inside the following word

blocks.note: a turn is a stage act
F is the abbreviation for fellow
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: Strike a man with an iron bar, taking it in turns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In turn' reads as 'one after another', but it means inside a stage turn.
explanation.definitionFit: As verbs, to affect and to impact both mean to have an influence on something.

clue.text: Put up at home, having no friend around

indicators.note: around means encircling, so the friend wraps round the home

blocks.note: taken as written
a mate is a friend
someone at home is in

explanation.surface: Someone stays in at home with no friends about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put up' suggests giving someone a bed; it is putting a candidate forward.
explanation.definitionFit: To put someone up for a post or award is to nominate them as a candidate.

clue.text: Split I discerned in British cult

indicators.note: something discerned in a thing is seen inside it, so the letter goes within

blocks.note: B is the abbreviation for British
a sect is a cult
taken as written

explanation.surface: The speaker detects a rift within a British cult.
explanation.definitionFit: To bisect is to cut into two halves, to split.

clue.text: Undernourished family in Southern US city

indicators.note: in places one word inside the other letters

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for southern
NY is New York
kin are family

explanation.surface: A hungry family living in a city in the American South.
explanation.definitionFit: Skinny describes someone very thin, as an undernourished person is.
